title: 14-in-1 Multi-Tool Hammer – Camping & Emergencies
descriptionHtml:
Out in the wilderness. Wrong tool at home. Classic.

The tent peg needs hammering in, the branch has to go and something needs screwing – but the toolbox is in the garage a hundred kilometers away.

The solution: 14 tools in pocket size

Hammer, pliers, saw, knife and screwdrivers – all in one compact tool that lives in the camping gear, the boat or the car's emergency kit. Always with you. Always ready.

Features

  • 14 tools in pocket size – hammer, pliers, saw, knife etc.
  • Handles real use – sturdy construction
  • Stored safely – protective case included
  • Fits in the glove compartment
  • The gift for him who has everything

Change of mind
